verdict.rationale: The only machine-readable spec in the evidence is an OpenAPI document at docs.x.ai/openapi.json. The shared docs site's llms.txt frames that site as the xAI developer documentation for Grok models and REST, so the spec most plausibly describes the vendor's model API rather than Grok Build's own interfaces. Grok Build's programmatic surfaces (headless mode and ACP over JSON-RPC) have no downloadable schema or spec in the evidence, so the sibling API's spec is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
